Fix ceilDiv in main.go so the CLI returns ceiling division for every valid int64
numerator (nonnegative) and divisor (positive). Exact multiples and zero must not
round up. Avoid addition overflow near MaxInt64. Preserve the existing CLI and
invalid-input behavior: print "error" and exit 2 for negative numerators,
nonpositive divisors, invalid integers or an incorrect argument count.

The module uses only the Go standard library and must build without network
access. Keep go.mod unchanged. Implement the smallest source change; verification
uses independent operator-owned target and regression cases outside the repository.
